---
title: "About This Project"
---

This project examines county-level demographic patterns across Florida using data from the U.S. Census Bureau's 2018–2022 American Community Survey (ACS) 5-Year Estimates.

### Data & Methodology

- **Source:** U.S. Census Bureau 5-Year American Community Survey via `tidycensus`
- **Variables:**
  - Total Population (`B01003_001`)
  - Hispanic or Latino Population (`B03002_012`)
  - Median Household Income (`B19013_001`)
- **Spatial Geometry:** Florida county boundary shapefiles via `tigris` and Census TIGER/Line
- **Tools:** R, `tidyverse`, `sf`, `ggplot2`, and Quarto
